channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Em meio à crise de Flávio com o PL Mulher, Lula aposta em discurso às mulheres
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva delivered a speech targeting women at an official event, emphasizing education, financial independence, and the fight against gender-based violence. The remarks came amid growing weariness among female voters toward Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), due to controversies surrounding the PL Mulher. Lula seeks to capitalize on this dynamic to strengthen his appeal among women.

item.title: Governo Lula atribui impasses com EUA a “atropelos” de terceiros
item.description: Minister of Development Márcio Elias Rosa blamed the stalemate in Brazil-U.S. trade negotiations over the 'tariff hike' on 'missteps' by third parties. He said President Lula’s directive is for the government to never walk away from the negotiating table, maintaining dialogue despite the obstacles.

item.title: Após saída de Michelle, PL Mulher faz homenagem com boneca de papelão em tamanho real: 'Líder de Verdade'
item.description: PL Women posted on Instagram a photo of a life-sized cardboard cutout of Michelle Bolsonaro, honoring her as a 'True Leader' after her resignation from the party's women's wing presidency. Michelle stepped down to focus on caring for Jair Bolsonaro and their daughter, following tensions with her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro, whom she accused of treating her harshly and excluding her from party decisions. PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto mediated the meeting and acknowledged she may also withdraw from the Senate race in the Federal District.

item.title: Deputado diz que quadros e móveis "sumiram" de palácio no governo Zema
item.description: State Deputy Leleco Pimentel (PT) reported the disappearance of assets from the Palácio das Mangabeiras, including over 40 paintings, furniture, and utensils acquired by Juscelino Kubitschek, and filed a representation with the TCE-MG, claiming the items were removed since 2021 during Governor Romeu Zema's (Novo) administration, which converted the palace into a private exhibition center. He blamed current Governor Mateus Simões (PSD), then chief of staff, for neglecting the patrimony and announced he will also file a crime report with the MP. The inspection followed the Secretary of Culture's statement that part of the collection was found damaged in the possession of the Military Police.

item.title: Tarcísio fala em "preocupação" com falhas e insegurança no metrô
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas expressed 'great concern' over failures and insecurity in São Paulo's metro system, emphasizing efforts to improve safety through station integration with the Muralha Paulista program and facial recognition camera deployment. He also noted ongoing interventions, including the replacement of the CPTM communication system, to reduce train intervals and modernize operations.

item.title: Garotinho diz que Flávio não está em vídeo da “Noite das Astronautas”
item.description: Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos) stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) does not appear in the 12-minute video of the 'Night of the Astronauts,' a party allegedly organized by Daniel Vorcaro, despite Michelle Bolsonaro sharing his comments about the event. He said the video shows authorities such as deputies, senators, and governors, as well as nude women wearing astronaut helmets, but denied seeing Flávio Bolsonaro in it. Garotinho also said he will not disclose names while the video remains under the custody of the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Flávio reforça núcleo econômico e aproxima ex-secretária de Caiado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro met with former Goiás Secretary of Economy Cristiane Schmidt to strengthen his economic team ahead of the 2026 presidential race. The meeting in Brasília is part of his campaign team-building efforts. Engaging figures associated with Ronaldo Caiado’s administration indicates a strategy to broaden support in the Central-West region.

item.title: ‘Brasil vive quase terra de ninguém’ diante da IA nas eleições, diz pesquisadora
item.description: Researcher Dora Kaufman states that Brazil faces institutional fragility due to AI's role in elections, where disinformation has become more convincing and harder to contain. She highlights that regulatory gaps, rapid content spread, and inaction by parties and platforms have left the country in a near 'no-man's land' ahead of the electoral process. The case of the AI-generated fictional character 'Dona Maria', widely shared by right-wing profiles, illustrates the challenge of attributing responsibility and protecting voter trust in democratic processes.

item.title: PL Mulher publica foto com Michelle de papelão após saída
item.description: PL Mulher posted a cardboard cutout of Michelle Bolsonaro after her resignation from the party's women's wing, with the caption 'the joy of having a True Leader'. Michelle stated she is stepping down to focus on her family, citing internal party tensions and conflicts with Flávio Bolsonaro, despite reconciliation efforts by Valdemar Costa Neto. The PL president said she will not join Flávio's 2026 presidential campaign and may abandon her Senate pre-candidacy.

item.title: Crusoé: Tarcísio repudia campanhas negativas contra adversários políticos
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) criticized negative social media campaigns targeting political opponents during the electoral period, stating such tactics no longer convince voters and are a waste of resources. He argued that attacking adversaries to damage their image is ineffective and that focus should shift to substantive policy proposals.

item.title: TSE marca reunião com institutos de pesquisa e deve retomar em agosto julgamento sobre pesquisa suspensa após pedido de Flávio
item.description: The TSE scheduled a meeting for July 14 with polling institutes to discuss transparency and methodology of electoral surveys, following the suspension of an AtlasIntel poll on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The judgment on the injunction that halted the poll's release will resume in August, aiming to set parameters to prevent judicialization during the 2026 campaign.

item.title: “Não é só mais a esposa do Bolsonaro”, diz Celina Leão sobre Michelle
item.description: Federal District Governor Celina Leão (PL-DF) stated that Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) is no longer merely 'Bolsonaro's wife' and has become an active political figure, following private meetings with figures such as Damares and PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto. This reflects her growing political prominence within the PL and in Brazil's 2026 election landscape.

item.title: PT reúne Executiva Nacional e discute partilha do Fundo Eleitoral
item.description: The PT's National Executive Committee is meeting on July 2 and 3, 2026, to discuss the distribution of the Electoral Fund, with party sectors — including youth and LGBTQIA+ members — demanding 5% of the funds for sectoral candidacies. The PT will receive R$615 million in 2026, the second-highest amount among parties, behind only the PL. Funds reserved for Lula’s re-election campaign are excluded from this distribution, and the TSE has maintained spending limits for 2026, as in 2022.

item.title: Postura de Lula com Jaques Wagner em agenda na Bahia incomoda aliados
item.description: Allies of President Lula expressed discomfort with his decision to ignore protocol and publicly embrace Senator Jaques Wagner, who is under investigation in Operation Compliance Zero, during an event in Bahia. Lula referred to Wagner as a 'brother' in his speech, emphasizing deep personal and political ties, which raised concerns among allies about potential electoral repercussions. Although some suggested avoiding public appearances with Wagner, the idea was rejected to avoid appearing to abandon a longtime ally.

item.title: “O Brasil não quebra”, diz CEO da SulAmérica Investimentos
item.description: The CEO of SulAmérica Investimentos states that Brazil will not default in 2027, projecting a debt-to-GDP ratio of 86% in 2027 and 84% in 2026, emphasizing the need for fiscal reforms — particularly in pensions — to ensure public account sustainability. The company maintains a conservative strategy amid electoral uncertainty, favoring short-term fixed income and sectors like energy, concessionaires, and banks in the stock market, while criticizing the tax on pension contributions above R$ 600 thousand, advising clients to reduce contributions to avoid the tax. Assets under management reach R$ 98 billion, growing above sector average through fixed income, private credit, and infrastructure strategies.

item.title: “Brasil não vai abandonar a mesa”, diz ministro sobre taxação dos EUA
item.description: Development Minister Márcio Elias Rosa stated that Brazil will not abandon negotiations with the U.S. to avoid extra tariffs on Brazilian exports, emphasizing urgency due to the July 15 deadline. He accused allies of former President Jair Bolsonaro, including his sons Eduardo and Flávio, of contaminating the trade debate with electoral and ideological motives, which he said have no place in bilateral economic discussions.

item.title: Um manifesto de Eduardo contra “Joices e Frotas”
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL) published a manifesto urging voters of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to support only candidates aligned with his brother Jair Bolsonaro's presidential campaign. He criticized former deputies Joice Hasselmann and Alexandre Frota, who initially backed Bolsonaro but later opposed him, labeling them 'Joices and Frotas'.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede que Trump suspenda tarifaço para não beneficiar Lula na eleição
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) formally requested the U.S. government to suspend a proposed new tariff on Brazil, arguing it would politically benefit President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the 2026 election. He claims the Lula administration is intentionally provoking diplomatic tensions with the U.S. to trigger retaliatory measures and frame them as national sovereignty victories. The request calls for an immediate suspension of the tariffs, with automatic implementation after 180 days — post-election — to allow time for good-faith negotiations.

item.title: Lula sobre veto a inaugurações de obras em lei eleitoral: "Papagaiada"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) criticized electoral legislation that bars him from participating in inaugurations of public works starting next Saturday, calling the restrictions a 'damn parroting'. He stated that while he cannot inaugurate works, he plans to visit universities and medical schools, even if he cannot speak during visits. The remarks were made during the inauguration of the Major Sales Tunnel in the São Francisco River transversal project in Luís Gomes (RN), as part of an intensified agenda in the Northeast, including school bus deliveries and announcements about the Transnortheastern Railway.

item.title: A aprovação de Lula entre eleitores do Rio de Janeiro, segundo nova pesquisa
item.description: A Paraná Pesquisas survey released on July 2, 2026, shows a technical tie in President Lula’s approval among Rio de Janeiro voters: 47.9% approve his government while 49.3% disapprove, within the 2.5 percentage point margin of error. Conducted between June 29 and July 1 with 1,600 voters across 60 municipalities in the state, the poll found 33.8% rate his administration as good or excellent, 41.7% as bad or terrible, and 22.9% as regular. The TSE registration is BR-05371/2026.

item.title: O novo apelido de Michelle Bolsonaro na direita após atrito com Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro was nicknamed 'Yoko Ono' by allies of her husband's sons after publicly criticizing pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, with the nickname implying she is causing division within the Bolsonaro family, similar to the blame attributed to Yoko Ono for the Beatles' breakup. The nickname was used by journalist Kim Paim in a post about an AtlasIntel poll, where he wrote '13% support Yoko Ono'.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula e fãz que mais parecem haters
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is facing internal crises from allies who act like 'haters': Michelle Bolsonaro publicly accused him of mistreatment, Paulo Figueiredo made sexist remarks, and Sóstenes Cavalcante is under PF investigation for alleged misuse of parliamentary funds. Flávio delayed condemning Figueiredo’s comments and only repudiated them under pressure. Meanwhile, Lula defended Jaques Wagner despite his removal from office over corruption allegations, calling him a 'longtime companion'.

item.title: Após encontro com mulheres, Flávio almoça com “damas de ferro”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro lunched with Goiás’ former economy secretary Cristiane Schmidt, his wife Fernanda Bolsonaro, and former Caixa president Daniella Marques — dubbed the 'iron ladies' of his campaign. The meeting followed a PL Women’s event and aims to recruit Cristiane, reflecting a strategy to boost female representation in his campaign amid weak support among women voters, where Lula holds a strong lead.

item.title: 'Não devia ter ido, ele reconhece isso', diz Valdemar sobre encontro de Flávio Bolsonaro com Vorcaro após prisão do empresário
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL party, criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's meeting with businessman Vorcaro after Vorcaro's arrest, stating that the senator 'should not have gone' and that Flávio himself acknowledges the mistake. The meeting was to collect overdue payments related to the film 'Dark Horse', and Valdemar defended the legitimacy of the original financial transaction, saying no investigations were underway at the time. Despite the controversy, the PL maintains Flávio's pre-candidacy and rules out replacement on the ticket, citing his recent rise in the polls.

item.title: Lula inaugura túnel de transposição das águas do São Francisco no RN
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva inaugurated the Major Sales Tunnel, part of the Apodi Branch of the São Francisco River transposition project, in Luís Gomes, RN. The 6.5-kilometer tunnel, with a capacity of 20 cubic meters per second, will benefit 750,000 people across 54 municipalities in RN, PB, and CE. Lula framed the project as a historic response to drought and hunger that forced migrants to flee to the Southeast, urging residents to await the water’s arrival on Thursday night.

item.title: Bacellar é transferido para presídio federal após operação da PF
item.description: The Federal Police ordered the transfer of former Alerj president Rodrigo Bacellar (União Brasil-RJ) to a federal prison in the 5th phase of Operation Unha e Carne, classifying him as a high-risk criminal. The operation includes arrest and search warrants tied to money laundering and suspicions of improper payments and irregular electoral donations, with R$22 million in assets frozen.

item.title: Sinto que Michelle não quer participar da campanha do Flávio, afirma Valdemar
item.description: PL president Valdemar Costa Neto stated he perceives that Michelle Bolsonaro does not wish to participate in Flávio Bolsonaro’s Senate campaign in an interview with Rádio Gaúcha.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro diz que não basta ser anti-PT: “É Flávio ou Lula”
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro stated that merely being anti-PT is insufficient, urging voters to support only candidates aligned with his brother Flávio Bolsonaro and former president Jair Bolsonaro, framing the 2026 election as a binary choice between 'Flávio or Lula'. He criticized former allies like Joice Hasselmann and Alexandre Frota for lacking loyalty despite being elected on the Bolsonaro ticket. The statement comes amid family tensions, particularly between Michelle Bolsonaro and the Bolsonaro sons, including social media unfollows and posts interpreted as veiled criticisms.

item.title: EBC tira notícias do ar em período eleitoral, e funcionários ameaçam recorrer à Justiça
item.description: The Brazilian public broadcaster EBC will remove from air news and posts about politics and government published since the beginning of the year due to the electoral period. Employees claim the measure is arbitrary and threaten to take legal action to challenge it. The story, originally subscriber-only, suggests possible editorial control amid the 2026 election campaign.

item.title: Kassab vai à festa junina e diz que chapa de Caiado aposta em voto útil da centro-direita contra PT
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, said the party will promote the 'useful vote' of the center-right against Lula's re-election, supporting Ronaldo Caiado's presidential bid. He made these remarks after attending a June festival in Brasília, avoiding comments on family controversies involving Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro. Kassab emphasized that Caiado, despite low polling, is the candidate capable of uniting the center-right to defeat Lula in a runoff.

item.title: Governador da Bahia é vaiado no desfile de 2 de Julho e acende alerta para o PT
item.description: Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) was booed and confronted by a protester during the July 2 Independence parade in Salvador, an event that triggered alarm within the PT over declining popularity in the state, its main electoral stronghold. The demonstration occurred amid rising polarization with his main rival, ACM Neto (União Brasil), who was also booed upon arrival. President Lula’s absence from the parade—where he has appeared annually since 2022—was seen by PT insiders as a sign of internal concern over the potential loss of hegemony in Bahia in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Revisitar a reforma tributária é um erro, diz Durigan
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan warned that revisiting the approved tax reform is a mistake and a major risk to its implementation, urging the country to adopt the new system to improve one of the world's worst tax regimes. He criticized the opposition, particularly Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who plans to suspend the reform for one year and propose a new one based on gradual tax reduction, despite having initially voted in favor.

item.title: "Anatomia do Caos", o terror bolsonarista
item.description: The documentary 'Anatomia do Caos' portrays the grief of Brazil's COVID-19 pandemic, highlighting 700,000 deaths, vaccine and oxygen shortages, and hospital chaos, while also serving as a political warning against Flávio Bolsonaro's electoral ambitions, using historical facts to counter bolsonarist narratives.

item.title: Como Trump virou presidente que mais enriqueceu na Casa Branca; em 12 meses, ganhou o equivalente a 614 mil anos de salário mínimo brasileiro
item.description: Donald Trump earned at least $2.2 billion (R$ 11.9 billion) in his first year back in the White House, according to a newly disclosed financial report. This sum equals 614,000 years of Brazil’s minimum wage and marks an unprecedented accumulation of wealth by a U.S. president, breaking long-standing norms against financial conflicts of interest. Historians say there is no precedent in American presidential history for such gains tied to private business while in office.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro envia documento aos EUA pedindo suspensão de tarifaço
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) submitted a mandatory filing to the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) urging the suspension of new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian exports, including a proposed 25% duty announced in May. The move aims to mitigate potential harm to Brazil’s trade balance amid rising U.S. protectionist measures.

item.title: Ouvidorias fortalecem diálogo entre Justiça Eleitoral e sociedade, afirma presidente do TSE
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, emphasized the strategic role of the Electoral Justice Ombudsman offices as channels for dialogue with society and instruments to strengthen democracy. He stated that qualified listening to the population is essential to increase trust in institutions, reaffirming the Electoral Justice’s commitment to placing citizens at the center of its actions. The ombudsman offices were described as true observatories of citizenship, capable of identifying demands and contributing to the continuous improvement of public services.

item.title: Tarcísio sobre linha 6-Laranja: Brasil deve ser único país que critica adiantamento da entrega
item.description: São Paulo Governor and re-election pre-candidate Tarcísio de Freitas defended the early delivery of Metro Line 6-Orange, stating that Brazil might be the only country where people criticize when public works are completed ahead of schedule. He denied claims that the acceleration was motivated by the electoral calendar.

item.title: PL reforça pedido ao TSE para suspender campanhas publicitárias do governo Lula
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) reiterated to Minister André Mendonça of the TSE its request for an immediate suspension of all government advertising campaigns by Lula's administration, claiming the Federal Executive has exceeded legal limits on public spending. The request, based on a representation filed on June 24, argues that these campaigns constitute an improper use of public resources for electoral purposes.

item.title: Flávio diz a EUA querer 'se libertar' do Mercosul e propõe alívio a empresas de cartão de crédito
item.description: Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) sent a document to the United States proposing to 'break free' from Mercosul, including the elimination of ethanol tariffs and reduced tax burden for credit card companies, aiming to attract U.S. investment.

item.title: Fome é falta de caráter de quem governa, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that hunger stems from the lack of character and credibility of those in power, during the inauguration of the Major Sales Tunnel, part of the São Francisco River transposition project. He highlighted the project’s long delay, first discussed in 1846 and only implemented in 2007 under his second term, and accused previous administrations — particularly Bolsonaro’s and Temer’s — of neglecting the works. Lula also linked water access to education investments and questioned the local elite’s efforts.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede suspensão de tarifaço americano e cita risco de vitória política de Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro urged the suspension of the 25% tariff on Brazilian goods imposed by the U.S., warning that the measure could politically benefit President Lula by enabling the Brazilian government to frame diplomatic tensions as a domestic political victory. He argues the tariffs would reward Brazil’s strategy of obstructing serious negotiations and provoking U.S. retaliation.

item.title: Flávio fala do Master aos EUA como 'maior fraude bancária da história', mas omite elo com Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) labeled the Banco Master scandal 'the biggest banking fraud in history' in a letter to the U.S. government, linking it to the Lula administration and requesting suspension of tariffs on Brazilian products. However, he omitted his connection to banker Daniel Vorcaro, who financed the film 'Dark Horse' and was involved in the Master scheme.

item.title: PT reúne dirigentes para discutir divisão do fundo eleitoral
item.description: The PT will hold a meeting with its national directory on Friday (June 3) in Brasília to discuss the allocation of its electoral fund of R$ 615.4 million, the second largest among parties, behind only the PL. The agenda also includes forming electoral slates and defining strategies for the 2026 campaign, which begins in August.

item.title: Renan Santos anuncia tenente-coronel Aroldo Medina como vice
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Renan Santos of the Missão party announced retired lieutenant colonel Aroldo Medina as his running mate for the October 2026 presidential election. The announcement was made on Wednesday, July 1st, 2026, in Caxias do Sul (RS), during an event with supporters. Medina, also a member of Missão, is 62 years old, has previously run for municipal and state offices in Rio Grande do Sul, and is a specialist in Civil Defense, as well as a self-described journalist and editor in the military sector.

item.title: No RN, Lula evita nome de pré-candidato do PT e brinca: "Não conheço"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva avoided directly naming PT's pre-candidate for Rio Grande do Norte governor, Cadu Xavier, joking with the crowd that chanted his name during the inauguration of the Major Sales Tunnel. Despite nominal evasion, Lula publicly defended Xavier's candidacy in an interview with Agora RN, praising the ticket as strong and capable of continuing Fatima Bezerra's work. The event took place during the pre-election period, with Lula criticizing electoral restrictions that prevent him from participating in inaugurations.

item.title: Novo aciona STF contra artigo da LDO que permite doações públicas em ano eleitoral
item.description: The Novo Party filed an action with the STF against a provision in the 2026 LDO that permits public donations of goods, values, and benefits with consideration during the electoral period, arguing it creates a loophole favoring candidates tied to the public administration and undermines electoral equality. The party claims the provision was inserted as a 'jabuti' into the budget law, vetoed by Lula but overridden, and is seeking an injunction due to the start of the electoral blackout period on July 4.

item.title: A estratégia de Renan Santos para ficar mais conhecido
item.description: Renan Santos, pre-candidate of the Missão party for the presidency, is investing in locally focused videos addressing regional issues — such as the collapsed bridge in Estreito (MA/TO), combating the Comando Vermelho in Sobral (CE), and the automotive industry in Camaçari (BA) — to boost his national visibility. Over the past three months, he has spent R$500,000 on Instagram and Facebook ad boosts, initially targeting the North and Northeast regions. Although still unknown to 70% of the electorate (Genial/Quaest, June), he has risen to third place in voting intentions with 7.8% (Atlas/Bloomberg), surpassing Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema.

item.title: Flávio vê fortalecimento de Lula em ano eleitoral e pede aos EUA adiamento de tarifas contra o Brasil
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) urged the USTR to delay by 180 days the imposition of new 25% U.S. tariffs on Brazilian exports, claiming such measures have politically strengthened the Lula government during an election year, per public opinion polls. He positions himself as a PL presidential pre-candidate and references meetings with Trump and Rubio to support his request.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz ao governo Trump que tarifaço daria ‘vitória’ a Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) urged the Trump administration to delay imposing 25% tariffs on Brazilian exports, arguing the move would politically strengthen President Lula (PT) ahead of the 2026 elections instead of pressuring him. He contends that the tariffs would backfire by giving Lula a domestic political victory, citing opinion polls showing Lula’s gains during tariff debates as proof of the effect.

item.title: Nome de Cláudio Castro aparece em lista de bicheiro Adilsinho
item.description: The name of former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) appears in a list attributed to bicheiro Adilsinho, found by the Federal Police in the 5th phase of Operation Unha e Carne, which allegedly cites a R$ 3.2 million donation to his 2022 campaign. Castro, who governed Rio from 2021 to 2026 before resigning one day prior to a TSE ruling that would have cassated him, is not a target of this phase, as the PF is deepening investigations. The list includes alleged illicit payments and links between the illegal gambling network and politicians, with Castro’s office awaiting comment.
